newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel minister okays venture fund tax exemption.
newsitem.headline: Israel minister okays venture fund tax exemption.

text.p: Israeli Finance Minister Dan Meridor has approved a tax exemption for venture capital funds representing foreign institutional investors that are exempt from capital gains tax in their home countries.
The tax exemption will apply only to venture capital funds that invest mainly in Israeli research and development companies, the ministry said in a statement.
The exemption, which still needs approval from the income tax commissioner, will be undertaken on a trial basis for one year.
It will benefit mainly U.S. pension funds interested in investing in Israel, the ministry said.

In addition, the tax that venture capital funds must pay on realising capital gains for investors who are not exempt from such a tax in their own countries will be lowered from 36 percent to 25 percent.
